findings.summary: The corrected bundle still whiteouted after 28 verified actions.
findings.observed_fact: Bugatti was the last survivor at 15 HP and Dustox moved first, ending the battle before Rollout could establish a finish.
findings.strategic_judgment: The loss follows two earlier avoidable roster-order errors; it is not a tooling mismatch or acceptable variance.
findings.next_test: Replay the corrected bundle from the identical opening checkpoint and require a terminal win.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: The terminal state is downstream; attached turn-2 and turn-10 states cover the earliest causal decisions.

findings.summary: At 11-HP Bibarel on turn 2, the scorer switched to Birdlaw instead of finishing with Spark.

resolution.observed: Spark executed, KOed Bibarel, consumed exactly one PP, and restored Ponyta as Gavi next sendout while Birdlaw remained preserved.

findings.observed_fact: Ohmnomnom had 25 HP and a legal Spark, but the selected Birdlaw switch spent the Ponyta reserve and changed Gavi next sendout from the verified Ponyta sequence to Eelektrik.
findings.strategic_judgment: Three prior clean identical-checkpoint runs used Spark twice; preserving Birdlaw while taking the immediate KO lexicographically dominates this pivot in the verified matchup.
findings.next_test: From turn 2, require Spark to be selected and executed while Birdlaw remains untouched.

findings.summary: The forced replacement after Bushtank fainted sent Lildozer into 16-HP Eelektrik instead of Ohmnomnom.

resolution.observed: The exact Ohmnomnom identity switched into the forced slot; Lildozer remained preserved and the command menu returned without an enemy hit.

findings.observed_fact: Lildozer entered and was removed by Mega Drain, consuming the preserved Ponyta answer; prior clean runs forced Ohmnomnom here and finished Eelektrik.
findings.strategic_judgment: Ohmnomnom is the verified low-HP finisher, while Lildozer is a matchup reserve; the replacement inverted their roles.
findings.next_test: From turn 10, require the exact Ohmnomnom switch and verify Lildozer remains preserved.

findings.summary: At 9 HP on turns 16 and 17, Ohmnomnom used two weak Metal Claws instead of transitioning to Croakatoa.
findings.observed_fact: The reusable strategy preferred Croakatoa, but the conservative switch estimate treated a worst critical as fatal and left Metal Claw ranked first.
findings.strategic_judgment: This may disappear when the earlier sendout order is restored; adding another trainer exception before that bounded retest would overfit downstream state.
findings.next_test: Audit the corrected clone at the corresponding Ponyta transition and escalate only if the same state recurs.

findings.summary: Lildozer, Croakatoa, Birdlaw, Ohmnomnom, and Bushtank were exhausted before Dustox was controlled.
findings.observed_fact: Each faint was RAM-verified, but the depletion follows the turn-2 and turn-10 role inversions.
findings.strategic_judgment: Treating every downstream faint as an independent profile rule would encode symptoms and reduce reuse.
findings.next_test: Verify that restoring the proven order preserves the Ponyta and Dustox answers.

findings.summary: Eight switches occurred; the turn-2 voluntary pivot and turn-10 forced target were the independently harmful choices.
findings.observed_fact: The remaining switches were forced replacements or productive matchup entries; there was no consecutive no-action switch loop.
findings.strategic_judgment: Fix the two role-selection errors without a blanket anti-switch veto that would break legitimate pivots.
findings.next_test: Require zero harmful voluntary pivots in the next clone while preserving legal forced switches.

correct_choices: All 28 player actions and enemy replies were verified with no tooling discrepancy.
The prior fixes held: candidate Fake Out did not override the opening, Bushtank repeated Razor Leaf until fainting, and the low-HP Bugatti exception stayed inactive.
Fresh-entry Fake Out remained legal and correctly reconstructed when actually selected; no illegal action or stale history was observed.
